purpose: Machine-readable desirability rubric for the Lens vision-judge and static linters. The gate stack already verifies correctness; this file is the only place desirability is scored.

E.label: evidence-backed
E.definition: Dated study, enforced platform requirement, or published measurement traceable to a primary source in sources.json.

P.label: practitioner-consensus
P.definition: Named practitioners agree; no measurement exists.

H.label: house-taste
H.definition: Our opinion. Defensible, unmeasured, never described to a client as best practice.

evidencePolicy.enforcement: A check.action MUST be one of actionVocabulary and MUST NOT exceed the maxAction of its tag. Remediation instructions belong in check.remediation, never in check.action. install.sh step 7 enforces this.

invariant: A check may never be assigned an action stronger than its evidence tag permits. Raising a tag requires a new primary source added to sources.json in the same commit.

failureModes.note: Every check must serve exactly one of these four. A check serving none of them is house taste and must be tagged H.
failureModes.duplication: The generator's fingerprint is more legible than the brand.
failureModes.thinness: Copy and imagery cannot answer a purchase question.
failureModes.missingSignals: No address, phone, policies, or real reviews.
failureModes.borrowedAssets: Stock photography, placeholder images, framework-default colour.

checks.name: structural-template-duplication
checks.detect: TF-IDF cosine over tag+sorted-class token stream per template, plus hash of ordered section schema type list and CSS custom-property block; compare against every prior generation.
checks.calibrationNote: Establish the baseline cosine spread among genuinely distinct human-built themes before enforcing. An untuned threshold either never fires or always fires.

checks.name: cosmetic-only-differentiation
checks.detect: Three-level diff vs base theme: (a) section/snippet filenames and schema type values, (b) DOM structure per template, (c) CSS declarations excluding custom-property values. Cosmetic when (a) and (b) are >=90% identical and only (c) values differ.
checks.operationalTest: No two generated stores may be inter-convertible through theme settings alone.

checks.name: fraud-correlated-metadata
checks.detect: Favicon presence and non-default hash; hostname hyphen/dot/digit counts; TLD length; positive payment tokens /\b(paypal|apple pay|google pay|shop pay)\b/i vs negative /\b(bitcoin|usdt|crypto|wire transfer|western union)\b/i; review-platform link presence.
checks.note: Domain age is the highest-importance feature but is not ours to change. That is exactly why every other feature must land on the legitimate side when the domain is new.

checks.name: thin-product-description
checks.detect: Rendered pixel height of description container at 390x844; word count; specs table presence (table, dl, [class*="spec"]); duplicate description text across products.
checks.companionCheck: Assert a[href*="return"], a[href*="refund"] exists on the product page.

checks.name: structural-credibility-gaps
checks.detect: Count a[href^="tel:"]; a[href^="mailto:"] and whether domain matches /(gmail|hotmail|outlook|yahoo|proton)\.com/i; street address regex or [itemtype*="PostalAddress"] in footer; policy links; HEAD every internal link; spellcheck visible text excluding brand allowlist.
checks.staleness: Underlying study is 2002. The ITEMS survive because they are structural; the MAGNITUDES are 24 years old, pre-mobile, and must never be quoted as current.

checks.name: stock-and-placeholder-imagery
checks.detect: Test img[src], srcset candidates and CSS background-image URLs against a host blocklist; check naturalWidth on product images and naturalWidth vs clientWidth for upscaling.
checks.prohibition: Never attach a conversion percentage to this check. No primary study measuring custom-vs-stock photography conversion lift is reachable; every such figure traces to agency marketing.

checks.name: manufactured-urgency
checks.detect: [class*="countdown"], [data-countdown], or a text node matching /\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2}/ that mutates under MutationObserver; visible-text regex /only \d+ left|hurry|ends (today|soon)|limited time|selling fast|\d+ (people|others) (are )?viewing/i.

checks.name: unverifiable-trust-badges
checks.detect: img whose src/alt/class matches /(trust|secure|badge|seal|guarantee|verified|ssl|norton|mcafee)/i; test whether wrapped in an anchor resolving to a third-party verification host; count total badges.
checks.doubleEdge: Testing found a homemade seal outperformed real SSL seals from established vendors except one. Decorative badges can raise naive-user trust while matching a consumer-body fraud heuristic. Warn only; never block.

checks.name: llm-style-vocabulary
checks.detect: Case-insensitive whole-word match against the 407 style-tagged rows of excess_words.csv. DO NOT STEM - the source counts inflections separately. Compute distinct style words per 100 words on blocks of >=100 words.
checks.calibrationNote: The threshold is ours, not sourced. The source method is explicitly corpus-level and states it cannot identify individual documents. Every measurement behind the word list is on ACADEMIC prose; marketing copy has far higher legitimate base rates for elevate, crafted, curated, seamless. Calibrate against our own human-written Shopify corpus before this blocks anything.
checks.refreshReason: Markers decay. 'delve' dropped off sharply during 2025. Log which rules fire so decay is observable.

checks.name: cliche-headline-templates
checks.detect: Regex tripwires on headline and tagline nodes only.
checks.rationale: Precision is high because patterns are multi-token. Recall does not matter because we control the generator and can retry.
checks.remediation: Regenerate the headline. This is a rewrite instruction, not an enforcement level - a P-tagged check may never block a build.
checks.correction: Until 2026-07-25 this check carried action:"regenerate", which is not a member of the enforcement vocabulary and exceeded the maxAction its P tag allows. A practitioner-consensus check was able to hard-stop a build. Corrected to warn + remediation.

checks.name: cross-store-copy-homogenisation
checks.detect: Pairwise similarity across every generated store on four axes: lexical n-gram Jaccard, POS-sequence syntactic, embedding cosine semantic, style.
checks.caveat: Source is a working paper, not peer reviewed, and its domain is restaurant social posts, not storefronts. The 0.85 figure is ours.

checks.name: default-framework-accent-hue
checks.detect: Collect computed color, background-color, border-color and gradient stops; convert to HSL; compute area-weighted dominant chromatic hue excluding S<0.10, L<0.08, L>0.92.
checks.threshold: HSL hue 236-274 deg, S>0.70, L 0.52-0.70. In OKLCH the equivalent band is 274-306 deg. Never mix the two numbers.
checks.correction: Tailwind v4 publishes OKLCH, not hex. A detector holding only v3 hexes silently stops firing on v4 stores. Both generations are recorded. The 236-274 deg HSL band survives the v3-to-v4 palette change.
checks.honestyRequirement: The arithmetic is verified; the claim that AI over-produces this hue is folklore with no measurement behind it. And half the folk explanation is false: shadcn/ui's default base is Neutral, --primary: oklch(0.205 0 0), chroma exactly zero. Never repeat the shadcn half.

checks.name: emoji-as-icon-set
checks.detect: Regex /[\u{1F300}-\u{1FAFF}\u{2600}-\u{27BF}\u{FE0F}\u{1F900}-\u{1F9FF}]/u over rendered text nodes; for each hit check for role="img" plus non-empty aria-label, or aria-hidden="true" plus adjacent visible text; count emoji appearing as leading child of repeated siblings.

checks.name: flat-single-elevation
checks.detect: Collect computed box-shadow, normalise whitespace and colour notation, count distinct non-none values; parse y-offset and blur.
checks.evidenceLimit: Expert observation on a single project with no inter-rater statistics. No quantitative link between shadow-token count and perceived quality exists anywhere.

checks.name: hierarchy-inversion
checks.detect: Per section compute prominence vector (rendered area, distance from top, max font-size, background contrast vs page) against content-weight proxy (word count, CTA presence, product-data density); flag top-decile-area elements holding a single text node under 4 words; count distinct font-weight and text color values.
checks.calibrationNote: The 2-and-3 numbers are ours. No published basis.

aestheticScore.purpose: Interpretable screenshot-level aesthetic signal for Lens. Report as a signal, never as a verdict.
complexityFeatures: quadtree leaf count by minimum colour/intensity entropy
text group count via modified X-Y cut
colourfulnessFeatures: percentage of pixels per W3C named colour (16)
mandatoryCaveats: Roughly 50 percent of variance is unexplained.
A fine-tuned CNN scores better (r=0.85 vs r=0.59) but is not interpretable; we prefer being able to tell a merchant why a page scored low.

doNotBuild.name: em-dash-density-as-authorship-signal
doNotBuild.reason: Measured across 12 models and ~240k words, and the measurement kills the rule. Human baseline 3.23 per 1000 words; GPT-5.4 is 1.43 and Llama is 0.00 - both BELOW humans. Expert annotators coded dash presence as a HUMAN tell. At headline length a 12-word headline expects 0.127 em dashes at the worst model rate vs 0.039 for humans. Acceptable as a brand-voice preference; never as an authorship judgement.

doNotBuild.name: third-party-ai-text-detectors-on-marketing-copy
doNotBuild.reason: Published minimum input lengths: Turnitin 300 words, OpenAI ~150-200, Originality.ai 100, GPTZero 50, Pangram 50. Industry floor is 50 words; a Shopify hero headline is 5-20, so any detector call is outside every vendor's stated operating range. Ethical constraint: seven detectors on 91 non-native-English essays produced a 61.22 percent false-positive rate vs ~5.19 percent for native speakers - the mechanism is low perplexity, not AI authorship. Independent testing found all 14 detectors below 80 percent accuracy. Use auditable pattern rules only.

doNotBuild.name: penalising-conventional-layout
doNotBuild.reason: Prototypicality is the strongest predictor of first impression (eta-p-squared 0.812), ahead of complexity (0.581), and complexity actively degrades search efficiency and recall. Flagging symmetric centring, three-column feature rows, or low visual complexity optimises AGAINST the evidence. The defensible targets are duplication, thinness, missing signals and borrowed assets.

unestablished: There is no study of AI-generated storefronts. Every rule here transfers from an adjacent domain and each transfer is an inference.

The serious design press has not published an analysis of the AI visual signature. The credible base is two expert-review articles plus a computational-aesthetics literature that predates the phenomenon.
Expert humans do not agree on 'is this slop' - Cohen's kappa from -0.15 to 0.29 among trained annotators. Prefer an ensemble with a structured rubric over a single scalar verdict.

These intuitive proxies have NO supporting evidence and are tagged H wherever used: distinct type sizes used vs defined, identical vertical rhythm, identical card radius, gradient count and angle uniformity, saturation clustering, glassmorphism, zero asymmetry, tricolon layouts.
sourceResolution: Every sourceIds value MUST resolve to an id in sources.json. The provenance gate fails the build if any does not.
